name: Open windows
description: The windows you have open, and a click to switch to one. Needs the window list turned on: rmpr windows enable.

groupByApp.label: Group windows by application
groupByApp.description: One button per application, as KDE and Windows do, with a mark per window. Clicking moves through that application's windows.

pinned.label: Pinned applications
pinned.description: Desktop entry ids ("org.kde.dolphin"), kept on the taskbar in this order whether or not they are running. Right-click a button and choose "Pin to taskbar" rather than typing them.

thisScreenOnly.label: Only this screen's windows
thisScreenOnly.description: Each monitor's panel lists the windows on that monitor, as Windows does with "show taskbar apps on the taskbar where the window is open".

thisDesktopOnly.label: Only this desktop's windows
thisDesktopOnly.description: The windows on the virtual desktop in front, as KDE's own task manager and Windows both do. Off lists every window on every desktop. A window set to be on all desktops is always listed.

showTitles.label: Show titles
showTitles.description: The window's title beside its icon, as far as the widest a button gets. Off, buttons are icons alone and the title is one hover away.

iconSize.label: Icon size
iconSize.description: 0 follows the panel's thickness, so resizing the panel resizes the icons with it.

iconScale.label: Icon size, as a share of the button
iconScale.description: How much of a button's height the icon fills, in percent. 100 leaves no room around it; the default leaves a little. Ignored when "Icon size" is set to an exact number of pixels.
